description: This file appears to be a Markdown documentation file describing the 'Request' class in the Playwright API, including its methods, events, properties, and usage examples.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request made by a page, providing methods to access request details, response, failure information, and related events.

methods.name: allHeaders
methods.description: Returns an object with all the request HTTP headers in lower-case, associated with this request.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Returns null unless the request has failed, then returns the error text of the failure.

methods.name: frame
methods.description: Returns the Frame object that initiated this request. Note that in some cases it may throw if the frame is not available.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Returns an object with the request HTTP headers. Header names are lower-cased.

methods.name: headersArray
methods.description: Returns an array of all the request HTTP headers, with headers not lower-cased, including multiple entries for headers like 'Set-Cookie'.

methods.name: headerValue
methods.description: Returns the value of a specific header by case-insensitive name.

methods.name: isNavigationRequest
methods.description: Indicates whether this request is driving a frame's navigation.

methods.name: method
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request (e.g., GET, POST).

methods.name: postData
methods.description: Returns the request post body as a string if any.

methods.name: postDataBuffer
methods.description: Returns the request post body in binary form as a Buffer, if any.

methods.name: postDataJSON
methods.description: Parses the request post body as JSON or URL-encoded data if applicable, returning a corresponding object or null.

methods.name: redirectedFrom
methods.description: Returns the previous Request object if this request was redirected by the server; null otherwise.

methods.name: redirectedTo
methods.description: Returns the new Request object issued by the browser if the server responded with a redirect.

methods.name: resourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type perceived by the rendering engine, such as 'document', 'script', 'image', etc.

methods.name: response
methods.description: Returns the associated Response object if received, or null if not available.

methods.name: serviceWorker
methods.description: Returns the Service Worker that is performing the request, if any (Chromium only).

methods.name: sizes
methods.description: Returns size information for the request: request body size, headers size, response body size, and response headers size.

methods.name: timing
methods.description: Returns timing metrics for the request such as start time, domain lookup time, connect time, etc.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the request.
